about.en: ONEchain, formerly CROSS, is a gaming-oriented, EVM-compatible Layer 1 blockchain developed by OGF Corp (formerly NEXUS) that offers SDKs and contracts for in-game asset ownership. Its token trades as CROSS on most exchanges and its BNB Smart Chain contract still reports the symbol CROSS; data providers have renamed it ONE since the 2026 rebrand, which did not change the token contract. It is unrelated to Harmony's ONE.
